labels.name: documentation
labels.rationale: Reports a broken link in the root documentation; the reporter also asks how to contribute the fix.

body:
Thanks for finding the broken link. Could you name the page and the link in this issue (the body doesn't say which one)? That lets a maintainer check it quickly.

For contributing the fix, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and, if you use AI tools, [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md). Pull requests are limited to collaborators, so describe the change in an issue first. Earlier issue #4029 asked the same thing about PRs from forks and was closed as completed.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
